executionOrder: Ten sequential independent pytest rounds, same three IDs and order every round. Each original function-scoped fixture creates a new owner/host/UDF and closes independently. No concurrent native UI runs.
originalDiagnosticMainRetained: Two diagnostic cases use their original nvr24 outer exception-only main and linked product sources. Not C04 host clones.
capture: Unmodified pytest/JUnit/stdout, existing naturally-produced receipts, timestamp/duration/exit, post-round read-only cleanup checks. No per-event logger, debugger, taps, sleeps or critical-path probes.

classification.STABLE_REPRODUCTION: 10/10 same SECRET_BOUNDARY_UNCONFIRMED, without PASS or other first-failure points.
classification.INTERMITTENT_REPRODUCTION: At least one PASS and at least one SECRET_BOUNDARY_UNCONFIRMED among the fixed ten; mixed outcomes take precedence over high observed fail frequency.
classification.NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_10: 10/10 PASS, not a claim of resolution.
classification.OTHER_OR_INCOMPLETE: Any other failure/error remains individually reported; no forced classification as no-reproduction if denominator incomplete or non-green.
